summary: Imported Tesoreria app (FastAPI+Mongo, React). Backend: smoke test of 70+ GET endpoints (47 company-scoped x 3 companies + 25 global + company_id-query variants) for all 3 demo roles - zero 5xx. Commercialista isolation verified (sees only Alfa/Beta; Gamma APIs 404, Gamma company_id never exposed in group/aggregate endpoints). Assistant demo /api/assistant/ask answers correctly. Frontend: demo quick-login buttons fill credentials and login works; group dashboard renders KPIs and both charts; all 38 sidebar routes + company page + guide subpage load with no page errors, no console errors and no 4xx/5xx for titolare. Core flows tested: movimenti filters (direction/search incl. empty state), fatture list, riconciliazione manual-match dialog + AI suggest, assistant suggested question and free-text question. Commercialista UI: company selector only Alfa/Beta, Gamma page shows 'Azienda non trovata o non accessibile', /utenti shows 'Accesso non consentito'.

minor.issue: Return 422 without required query params (by design, not a bug)

integration_issues.issue: Page still calls GET /api/members which returns 403 (logged as console error) before showing 'Accesso non consentito'; cosmetic - could skip the call based on role
dashboard?weeks=8 requested twice (404 both) - double fetch, harmless

action_items: Optional: avoid calling /api/members on /utenti for non-titolare roles to remove the 403 console error
critical_code_review_comments: Gamma Srl's name shows up in commercialista's /deadlines, /forecast and /intercompany as the counterparty on Alfa/Beta's own invoices (e.g. 'Fattura 44/2026 · Azienda Gamma Srl'). This is the user's own data, not a leak; Gamma's company_id and data are never exposed.
The seed data and the browser clock are both around Oct-Nov 2026, so 'Entrate del mese' shows 0 € and many deadlines show as 'scaduta'. This is expected for the demo data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Smoke test at /app/backend/tests/test_smoke_all_gets.py covers all GET endpoints for all roles plus commercialista isolation. Company IDs: Alfa 19a8d8b7..., Beta bb5bb271..., Gamma 05fda620-a82d-430c-b5b5-f86c6554de50.
